SELECT account_id, region, order_count, difference_from_overall_average, difference_from_overall_average - region_average_difference AS excess_over_region_average
FROM (
  SELECT account_id, region, order_count, difference_from_overall_average,
         AVG(difference_from_overall_average) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS region_average_difference
  FROM (
    SELECT o.account_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS order_count,
           COUNT(*) - AVG(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS difference_from_overall_average
    FROM "order" AS o
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = o.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3
  )
)
WHERE difference_from_overall_average > region_average_difference
ORDER BY excess_over_region_average DESC
LIMIT 10
